title: Error in template-var-assignment migration: Cannot read property 'start' of undefined

body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/core ### Description Running `ng update @angular/core` fails after the Static Query Migration. The output we are getting: ``` Using package manager: 'npm' Collecting installed dependencies... Found 99 dependencies. ** Executing migrations for package '@angular/core' ** ------ Static Query Migration ------ With Angular version 8, developers need to explicitly specify the timing of ViewChild and ContentChild queries. Read more about this here: https://v8.angular.io/guide/static-query-migration The template migration strategy uses the Angular compiler internally and therefore projects that no longer build successfully after the update cannot use the template migration strategy. Please ensure there are no AOT compilation errors. ------------------------------------------------ Cannot read property 'start' of null ``` ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction The error seems to be thrown in [html_variable_assignment_visitor.ts](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/1a5c7112e0afc33202961bf43cac42b9a49e056d/packages/core/schematics/migrations/template-var-assignment/angular/html_variable_assignment_visitor.ts#L73), where the visitor is called, but span is undefined. In this case the node itself seems to be a variable assignment in a spans click listener: ``` {"span":{"start":37,"end":59},"receiver":{"span":{"start":37,"end":37}},"name":"showDatepicker","value":{"span":{"start":54,"end":59},"value":true}} ``` A stripped down version of the HTML template the node is pointing to: ``` ``` ## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:**
